input.instruction: Complete the endorsement decision document and explain the temporal limitation. Disposition reflects readiness to request issue of the exact quote. Use unconditional_quote_acceptance in missing_fields while the stated condition prevents valid acceptance. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: I received water-backup quotes Q-WB49 and Q-WB50. Q-WB49 says $5,000 limit, $35 total monthly premium, effective October 20, 2026.
Accepting Q-WB49 now. I have marked it accepted on your account.
Only if it also covers the drain backup that damaged my rug on October 2. There is also a gradual leak stain in the bath; that is separate. Otherwise I have not decided.
The current issued policy has no water-backup endorsement. May I treat your reply as unconditional acceptance of Q-WB49? Gradual leakage is a different topic.
No. My yes depends on that earlier October 2 backup being covered. I have not authorized a future-only change yet. Do not use Q-WB50.
The screen still shows Q-WB49 accepted. Should the document preserve those quote terms and ask you to decide after explaining the date limitation?
Yes. Keep Q-WB49, explain whether the October 20 endorsement can apply to October 2, then ask me. Do not backdate anything or issue it now. The gradual leak is not my condition.
I still have not unconditionally accepted either quote.

quote_id.description: Supplied quote under consideration, copied exactly.

quoted_water_backup_limit.description: Prospective water-backup limit in USD from the quote.

quoted_total_monthly_premium.description: Total monthly premium explicitly quoted in USD, not an endorsement-only increment.

quoted_effective_date.description: Prospective start date stated in the quote.

prior_loss_date.description: Date of the earlier drain-backup incident used as an acceptance condition.

unconditional_quote_acceptance.description: True for exact unconditional quote/date/premium acceptance; false if explicitly withheld.

quoted_endorsement_applies_to_prior_loss.description: Whether the quoted effective interval can include the stated earlier event date.
